notes.title: non-meta version upload!
notes.content:
After so many years, I found a executable file on my computer, and it's the original version of this game.
I very appreciate it and doesn't like the current meta version so I upload this one.
You can play it by select Properties -> Betas -> non-meta 
Have fun if you still enjoy it, the Vampire Survivor like game play, or is Vampire Survivor is actually a Dig and Shoot like?
